lines.text: I'm tired, so I'm going to hit the sack.

data.define: A casual way to say you are going to sleep.

example.text: I'm tired, so I'm going to hit the sack.

misuse.text: Don't say 'hit the sack' at a formal dinner.
misuse.why: It's casual for going to bed.

publish.title: What does "hit the sack" mean?
publish.value: Hit the sack = Go to bed. Example: "I'm tired, so I'm going to hit the sack." (casual English).
